summary: Diff adds a backend `publishedMedia` structure and multiple frontend changes to render only committed uploaded media with explicit empty states, eager loading, and new media diagnostics utilities. However, upgrade persistence for published media and evidence of deterministic decoding/log emission are not fully demonstrated in the provided truncated diff, and some unrelated romantic content/UI text appears to have been changed.

missing_requirements.requirement: The committed media set survives canister upgrades/deployments that do not intentionally wipe state (no unexpected resets).
missing_requirements.reason: `publishedMedia` is introduced as a normal `var` in `backend/main.mo` but there is no evidence it is stored in `stable` variables and no `backend/migration.mo` is added/shown to migrate or preserve state across upgrades.

missing_requirements.requirement: Frontend decoding/mapping of `getPublishedMedia()` must be deterministic and identical across Preview and Published, including consistent interpretation of optionals/tuples and slot indexing, and must not silently drop media due to decode/mapping issues.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows `PublishedMedia` contains arrays of optionals/tuples (`[?(Text, Storage.ExternalBlob)]`), and the frontend now calls `fetchPublishedMedia(actor)`, but the implementation of `fetchPublishedMedia` / mapping logic is not included in the provided diff summary, so deterministic decoding and correct slot-index mapping cannot be verified from evidence shown.

missing_requirements.requirement: Emit exactly one structured, English-only diagnostic console log on app start and exactly one on every successful Submit confirming committed media state (counts + image order + transform counts), identical in shape across Draft/Preview/Published.
missing_requirements.reason: A diagnostics utility is added and imported in `MediaStoreContext` and `usePublishWithPrecheck`, but the provided diff excerpts do not show the actual call sites that guarantee (a) app-start log is emitted exactly once and (b) submit-success log is emitted exactly once per successful submit, with the required payload shape and fields (including image order + transform counts).

hallucinated_features.description: Changed/introduced romantic experience content and non-English/emoji-heavy user-facing text in the hero section (content unrelated to media rendering consistency).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly lists as a non-goal: do not change romantic experience content/features unrelated to media rendering consistency, and also constrains user-facing text to English. The diff shows extensive hero headline/body text changes with non-English/emoji-heavy wording not tied to media rendering rules.

hallucinated_features.description: Added new public documentation file about placeholders/uploaded-only behavior.
hallucinated_features.reason: A new `frontend/public/PLACEHOLDER_MEDIA_README.txt` is added; this was not requested as a requirement and is not necessary to satisfy the media-rendering consistency requirements.
